Context: 9. Special Maternity Leave

In case the maternity leave has not been availed, 60 days of Special  
Maternity Leave may be granted.  
The condition for death of a child soon after birth may be defined as up to 28 days after birth. A baby born with no signs of life at or after 28 weeks  
of gestation may be defined as stillbirth.  
Admissible only to a female Central Government servant with less than 2 surviving children and for child delivery only in an authorized  
Eligibility: hospital.
